results.title: Lingering Tides
results.overview: When Penghu is remembered only for its beaches and fireworks, where do the stories of everyday life and memory go? In the alleys of Magong, a small bookstore chooses to slow things down. Through walking tours, local markets, and grassroots actions, it invites people to reconnect with the place. What we document is not just a bookstore, but those who are willing to speak, to walk, and to stay. Culture is not something merely preserved—it is remembered through action.

results.title: Decluterring
results.overview: A college freshman becomes haunted by his childhood Muppets.

results.title: Inside
results.overview: Isn't it strange how few personal stories we know about something experienced by millions of women? Inside is a poetic exploration of abortion through the memories of women who have lived it. Fragmented reflections unfold through the language of flowers, archival footage, and abstract imagery, while the world outside presses in through expectations, judgment, and a noise that was never truly theirs to carry.

results.title: K3 Superhelden
results.overview: Hanne, Marthe en Julia get a special visit when Superhero Vonk shows up at their door with three superhero suits for them. K3 turns into superheroes, but soon they find out that there is a dark side to it...

results.title: AUL: The Forgotten Wolf
results.overview: In a village beneath a geothermal power plant, a local militia controls public order as a cover for its illegal operations. One night, a confrontation with Mala (50), a father who begins questioning their authority, ends in his murder. Hours earlier, he entrusts his karinding to his son, Gal (25), as if passing on a final mission. After witnessing his father's death, Gal accuses the militia, but no one believes him. Guided by the karinding, he enters a realm where myth and reality converge to uncover the truth and awaken his community's forgotten conscience.

results.title: At Friend's House
results.overview: Banji is at the absolute lowest point of his life. Wandering aimlessly while enduring starvation, fate reunites him with Tohan, an old friend who immediately invites him home and offers a plate of rice. However, that warmth shatters into a harsh reality when Banji learns the bitter truth: Tohan was recently laid off, his sibling is severely ill, and they survive solely by selling handmade teddy bears. Overwhelmed with guilt for consuming Tohan's precious food, Banji is instead gifted two teddy bears as a lifeline to rebuild his life.

results.title: Air Pangea
results.overview: A man prepares for death, washing and wrapping himself in the kafan as his mother reminds him only deeds and prayers matter. As the soul transcends the body, it confronts visions of the afterlife — demonic figures, mythical creatures, three guarded doors — exploring death through sex, drugs, and rock and roll as much as ritual and prayer. Plunged into a metaphorical sea of memory, love, and loss, he searches for his mother's voice amid the waves. He awakens on a lake shore met by angels. What lies beyond the waterfall? Sex drugs rock and roll?

results.title: A Story About Tiger's Roar
results.overview: Amid the harsh realities of life in Jakarta, Martha, a single mother working as a laundry worker, struggles to provide for her three year old son, Aldi. When Aldi begs for milk at a minimarket, Martha realizes she doesn’t have enough money. She almost steals it but backs out in fear. Desperate, Martha seeks help from her ex-husband and customers, but every door is closed. Mounting financial pressure and Aldi’s relentless cries push her further into despair. When her work is disrupted and a customer refuses to pay, she loses hope. Martha returns to the minimarket, waiting for the right.

results.title: Arthur & Clara
results.overview: Pretentious filmmaker Arthur and entitled high-profile actress Clara find themselves at the same rural farmhouse, to escape from their individual pressures. As they reluctantly start to connect, their shared vulnerability leads them on an accidental journey of self-discovery, revealing what it truly means to be seen.

results.title: Stay Good
results.overview: After causing a horrific accident, a young college student attempts to become a better person.

results.title: "Knock, Knock"
results.overview: Two people dressed as vampires. One clearly is. The other… isn’t so obvious. Who is the vampire? Open the door and find out!

results.title: Call The Office
results.overview: Call The Office is one of Canada’s most iconic music venues. The venue created a vibrant social hub in London, Ontario and thrived for generations. It brought such notable bands as Radiohead, The Tragically Hip, Bif Naked, D.O.A, Link Wray, and Bad Brains to London. It also helped launch the careers of musicians such as Danko Jones, Sum 41, Kittie, and Death From Above 1979.  From the voices of the bookers, staff, patrons, and bands, this documentary examines what made the place so special.

results.title: Felix Motel
results.overview: Felix Motel (2026)  Kim Martin Thomas  Starring Betty Boop (1930) and Felix the Cat (1931), Felix Motel is a quasimodo remake of The Cobweb Hotel, with a heavy influence from the 1960 classic, Psycho. The Cobweb Hotel is a 1936 animated short film directed by Dave Fleischer and produced by Fleischer Studios. Animated by David Tendlar and William Sturm, the setting is said to be one of Fleischer's desks, which the spider used to open the hoax hotel. Felix Motel, however, will be set in a Bates Motel inspired setting and will feature cameos from various public domain characters that include Tweety Pie, Popeye, Mickey and Minnie Mouse, to name just a few. Felix Hotel will not only pay homage to Psycho, but will have unsubtle nods to Scream, The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, Halloween and American Psycho. Set around the festive season of All Hallows' Eve, Betty will check into Felix's run-down motel, only to discover all is not what it seems.

results.title: Poeksie Woeksie
results.overview: A spin-off of the beloved comedy series, Orkney Snork Nie. Chaos ensues when Ouboet finds himself behind bars, despite being innocent. While Yollie deals with the family crisis, he must prove his innocence to make it home in time for his son’s wedding.

results.title: Rise of the Pumpkin: The Curse of Billy Hollow
results.original_title: Rise of the Pumpkin: The Curse of Billy Hollow
results.overview: A young boy stumbles upon a pile of pumpkins in the woods and decides to destroy them, unknowingly summoning a ruthless, pumpkin-faced killer who begins to hunt him down on Halloween night.

results.title: The Sleepwalker
results.overview: A college student, Niu Lang, turns his camera toward his roommate, Zhu Xing, who has a habit of sleepwalking, for a class project. In an attempt to capture his roommate's nocturnal behavior on film, he pursues what he believes to be a "true documentary." But one late night, an accident occurs.
